Title: Rectangle of 0 width or 0 height cannot change width or height after created

Body:
If I create a rectangle of 0 width, then I cannot change its width after that.
```python
from manim import *
rec1 = Rectangle(height=1, width=0)
print(f"{rec1.height} {rec1.width}")
rec1.height = 2
rec1.width = 1
print(f"{rec1.height} {rec1.width}")
```

Choices: bug, documentation, feature, question.
